verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that third-party delegation exists. Tax professionals can make payments for multiple clients under a single login, and the Batch Provider Software supports this. Taxpayers are pointed to tax professionals or payroll providers to pay for them, and there is guidance on accessing multiple enrollments. Nothing in the pack spells out the delegation scope, so this is only a glancing mention. Missing for 10: published authorization forms for delegates, defined roles and permission boundaries for third parties, a statement of which actions or signatures must remain with the taxpayer, and any independent corroboration.
